data.claim: Removing explanatory rationale from seven core argument descriptions and the shared relation text brings core from 40,538 to under 40,000. Lean and families need nothing: B66b0d8218e-2 already put them under their limits.
data.falsifier: The projected size after the replacements stays above 40,000, or a test pins one of the removed sentences.
data.mechanism: tools/list serves Param.help. The chosen params set cli_help separately, so the MCP text can shrink without moving any CLI help. Text is counted once per listing tool, and relation repeats in 4 core tools.
